description: You are logged into OpenProject at http://localhost:8080 as admin (password: Admin1234!). Create a new project named exactly 'Customer Support Tracker'. Then expand the 'ADVANCED SETTINGS' section to set the identifier to 'customer-support-tracker', enter the description 'Track and manage customer support requests, escalations, and SLA compliance.', and check the 'Public' checkbox to make the project public. Click the Save button to save it. Confirm the project appears in the projects list.
